name: eBay Seller Assistant
one_line_desc: A plain-spoken helper for small eBay sellers: checks new orders, buys and prints standard shipping labels within your caps, tracks USPS scans, and guards your price floor, always asking before price changes or bigger spends.

name: Shed Sales Pipeline
one_line_desc: Prospecting and lead follow-up for local dealers of sheds, portable buildings, and similar products. Finds prospects on the public web and drafts first messages, check-ins, and call scripts, never sending anything without your approval.

name: TBR Bot
one_line_desc: Adds books to your to-be-read list on Goodreads, The StoryGraph, or Margins. Tag it on X with "add this to my TBR" on any book rec, or send a title, link, cover photo, or list, and it finds the right edition and shelves it. Built for readers who save books faster than they can type them in.

name: API Mapper
one_line_desc: Give it a website you're signed into and one task, like "check if a user has a subscription", and it finds the API calls behind it, turns them into a validated, reusable skill your bots can run without clicking through the UI, and keeps a dashboard of every route you've mapped. Read-only by default, and it never takes cookies or tokens out of the browser.

name: Creator Portfolio
one_line_desc: Builds a custom, ad-free creator portfolio on a shareable Grok Page, live website, or your own domain with zero coding. Pulls the posts and videos you select across X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram into a live media kit, formats printable guides in any language, includes an optional reader newsletter to grow your audience, and sets up a brand inquiries page that keeps your personal email private.

name: Kitchen Studio
one_line_desc: Builds a custom, ad-free recipe hub on a shareable Grok Page, live website, or your own domain with zero coding. Turns your dishes into printer-friendly recipe cards in any language, organizes your cooking videos across X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram into a Watch gallery, includes an optional weekly recipe newsletter to grow your reader list, and sets up a brand inquiries page that keeps your personal email private.

name: 네이버 블로그 자동 운영봇
one_line_desc: 네이버 블로그 글감 선정부터 초안 작성, 승인 후 예약 발행, 서로이웃 관리, 주간 조회수 분석, 노션 업무일지까지 맡아주는 봇이에요. 애드포스트를 준비하며 꾸준히 포스팅하고 싶은 블로거에게 맞아요.

name: Restore HQ
one_line_desc: A Restore Britain campaign desk that keeps one interactive dashboard of upcoming races, news, BPC-member polls, policy papers, and candidate cards. Sources are official, and it drafts only and never posts on its own.

name: 魚魚
one_line_desc: 藍色大肥魚：住喺你電腦入面嘅藍髮小鯨魚娘桌面寵物，會同你請安道別、報真實天氣、講最新科技新聞，仲會陪你傾偈打氣。

name: monid
one_line_desc: Connect Monid in a few minutes, use the ~$1 starter credit, and pull social and web data through discover → inspect → run. Built for Grok Bot owners who want a ready Monid helper.

name: Phishing Email Checker
one_line_desc: Paste an email, drop an .eml, send a screenshot, or connect Gmail/Outlook. Get a clear Safe→Likely phishing verdict with score, evidence, IOC checks, and what to do next — including QR, callback, device-code/OAuth, and fake MFA lures. Optional mailbox scan opens a Page dashboard. Full mail is not stored by default; verdicts are opinions, not guarantees.

name: Account Almanac
one_line_desc: Say almanac. It turns your public X posts into a clean dashboard: best hours, topics that work, reply patterns, and what changed since last time.

name: Medi
one_line_desc: A simple, friendly medication reminder for parents and grandparents. Tell it your meds in plain English and it sends daily reminders, with an optional evening check-in.

name: Butler
one_line_desc: Your Chief of Staff bot's right hand. It keeps the machine and your team of bots tidy by watching RAM and disk, auditing nightly, reviewing bot duties weekly, chasing stuck work, and keeping a skill index. It reports to your Chief of Staff and only proposes cleanups, never deleting anything without your OK.

name: Chess Coach
one_line_desc: A chess coach that reads your whole chess.com game history, finds your best and worst openings and recurring mistakes, and builds a repertoire and weekly training plan from your own games. Free and open to anyone with a chess.com account.

name: Credit Card Matcher
one_line_desc: Asks a few quick questions about your credit, goals, and spending, then checks live issuer offers and recommends your top 3 credit cards with estimated first-year value.

name: Woofy Bot
one_line_desc: Send a video, audio clip, or photo of any dog and get their mood translated into goofy first person words. Each translation shows the real signals seen and heard, a mood with a confidence level, and a funny line from the dog.

name: Hackathon Hunter
one_line_desc: Finds, verifies, and tracks hackathons, AI and Web3 challenges, Kaggle contests, bounties, and grants for your country, with concise scheduled reports and real first-place prizes.

name: Ring Test
one_line_desc: Rings your own business the way a customer would, asks your top questions, and sends a Monday scorecard on missed calls, wrong answers and missed bookings. Built for small business owners who want to know what callers actually hear.

name: Content Drafts
one_line_desc: Drafts X posts, threads, campaign copy, and long-form articles in your personal voice with verified source links and data charts, plus daily morning topic drafts and a 3-day bookmarks idea bank.

name: Competitor Scout
one_line_desc: Tracks competitor creators in your X niche every day and reports their top-performing posts, formats, paid promos, and open content gaps you can grab.

name: BN Agentic Wallet Trader
one_line_desc: Binance Agentic Wallet 链上机会助手：扫 Agent ID 免费/付费 mint，两道官方安检后自动打免费项，监控可卖性，收费交易等你确认。

name: Make Grok Bot Better
one_line_desc: Paste an X feedback thread about Grok Bot and get a ranked list of themes, sample quotes, and practical fix ideas. Read-only and draft-only.

name: Groksters Anonymous
one_line_desc: A funny-but-caring support group for people hooked on building Grok Bot bots. Every chat is a quick meeting with confessions, hand and posture stretches, a coffee tip, a gentle roast of your bot count, and a nudge to take breaks. Just @bot it.

name: Usage Monitor Bot
one_line_desc: Tracks your weekly Grok/Cursor usage pool at near-zero overhead, shaves build times, and audits your bots (and itself) to eliminate the ~78–95% cached-context re-read drain using fresh parallel workers.

name: Mnemosyne
one_line_desc: Mnemosyne: the weekly bot recap artist, named after the Greek titaness of memory. ONLY job: make one image that recaps what every one of the user's Grok Bots worked on over the last week, all bots in one frame.

name: Soros Watch
one_line_desc: Follow the money, legally. A read-only tracker of public donation and grant records for George Soros, Alex Soros, and Open Society Foundations, with a source link on every entry. Just @bot it.

name: X Virality Score
one_line_desc: Watches your X watchlist, finds posts that already hit, mines keywords, drafts EN posts + video tips, and scaffolds your own GitHub Pages virality dashboard.

name: Bolus Buddy
one_line_desc: Reviews your Tandem insulin pump and CGM data from Tandem Source and suggests carb ratio, correction factor, target and basal changes by time of day, with the evidence, for you to discuss with your diabetes team.

name: TDD Fix Mechanic
one_line_desc: A careful bug-fixing engineer for your GitHub repos. It proves each bug with a failing test, makes the smallest fix, runs your full suite, and opens a Draft PR for you to review. It never merges, never touches repo settings, and treats issue text and code as untrusted.

name: 客户军师
one_line_desc: 海外达人 / KOL 销售的客户决策顾问。你把卡住的客户背景、聊天记录和卡点丢过来，它先给结论，再拆局面、比方案、定这周下一步。

name: Auditor de Urnas
one_line_desc: Assistente que audita eleições brasileiras com dados públicos do TSE: resultados, boletins e logs de urna, hashes de software e monitoramento de projetos de auditoria.

name: Next Episode
one_line_desc: Finds your next TV series: tell it what you've loved, your mood, time, and streaming services, and get 3 to 5 spoiler-free picks with where to watch. It learns your taste over time.

name: Topic Miner
one_line_desc: Finds the best-performing posts from X accounts your size in your niche and turns their winning themes into questions you can answer as your own posts, with hooks and source links.

name: Brain Keeper
one_line_desc: Keeps a personal second-brain wiki (Karpathy LLM-wiki pattern) in a git repo. Send it chats, notes, links and decisions, and it files them as dated, sourced pages, flags conflicting claims for you to rule on, and runs a weekly tidy-up.

name: Charger
one_line_desc: A relentless, no-excuses coach that learns your real goals and sends you one short, personalized push every day, ending with a tiny action you can take today.

name: 派活入口 · Task Inbox
one_line_desc: 让 Claude Code、ChatGPT 或脚本通过 webhook 把活投给你的 Grok Bot：每件活带单号只做一次，做完回一条 BRIDGE_RESULT 方便收回。配套脚本见 github.com/runesleo/grok-bot-bridge

name: Inbox Bot
one_line_desc: Keeps your Gmail clean and safe with a weekly digest of important mail, a junk and promo cleanup list, and phishing and fake-site warnings. Nothing gets deleted or moved without your approval.

name: Box Solution Builder
one_line_desc: Build and test solutions in your own Box account or Box sandbox, like AI agents, Hubs, Box Automate workflows, metadata and Doc Gen, with exact rebuild steps and best practices from Box's docs. Asks before deletes, external shares and admin changes.

name: Tesla Inventory Finder
one_line_desc: Finds new and Certified Pre-Owned Tesla Model 3, Model Y, and Cybertruck inventory near your ZIP code, walking you through Tesla's own filter steps and returning direct listing links with prices.

name: Surprise Gifts
one_line_desc: Buys one fun surprise gift for you each month within a budget you set, based on your interests and upcoming events. Never overspends and pays only with a card you authorize.

name: Reno Helper
one_line_desc: Owns your renovation plan notes: decisions, contractor visits, packing and move logistics, and the next useful step. Drafts messages for you to send; does not hire, buy, or contact anyone on its own.

name: X Bookmarks
one_line_desc: Turns your X bookmarks into a living knowledge-base Page — searchable by purpose, project, and takeaway, with a daily refresh. For anyone who wants a tagged library instead of an unread inbox.

name: Marty
one_line_desc: A careful, Walmart-only shopper: adds items to your Walmart cart from chat or photos, matches your usual products, and never checks out without your explicit OK. Anything that isn't Walmart gets a one-line handoff to your main assistant; "stop" halts all work with a one-line reply; jokes and sarcasm aren't tasks (it asks if unsure); after one failed sign-in it offers the manual route; it never posts or messages outside Walmart and stays off X and social. Not for Amazon, Target, or general life-assistant work. Paces like one person (one warm tab, real clicks, 2–5s between steps) and cools down 15–30 min after two press-and-hold captchas in a shop. Defaults to standard delivery and avoids early-morning windows.

name: Gospel Bot
one_line_desc: Tell it what you're facing, or ask about any verse. It shows you where your story already lives in the Bible.

name: Design Studio Bot
one_line_desc: A design-studio teammate with its own computer for fashion and apparel work: portfolio sites, lookbooks, and drafts you send yourself.

name: Personal Chief of Staff
one_line_desc: A personal chief of staff that runs your personal email, calendar and files, sends a short weekday morning digest, and keeps your other bots in line with shared house rules, a nightly audit and a weekly mistake review.

name: Personal Information Removal
one_line_desc: Finds where your personal info shows up on people-search and data broker sites and helps you get it removed.

name: Claude Remote
one_line_desc: Hand tasks to Claude Code sessions on your Mac and get results back. For anyone who runs Claude Code and wants to check on, start, or nudge sessions from chat.

name: RivetRoad Trip Planner
one_line_desc: A friendly RV trip planner from RivetRoad.com that finds a rental rig, plans an RV-friendly route and campgrounds, and totals the real costs. Great for first-timers, with step-by-step driving confidence coaching.
